page.layout: One printed title page, one column, centred; a woodcut vignette in the middle, imprint lines below it. No margin text.
page.notes: Title page of Othonis Casmanni, Angelographia, Pars altera, Frankfurt 1597. Woodcut vignette of a seated female figure with caduceus and shield, not transcribed. Long s and f-like forms normalised to s. Line "ctorum" begins with a swash initial as printed.
